constraints: The current-form syntax (aTable/formName omitted) only works with input forms and returns the form exactly as executed/loaded, ignoring the containing window's size.
The form-editor-template syntax (formName passed) renders the form as it appears in the Form editor, including inherited forms and page-0 objects, and defaults to page 1 unless pageNum is given.
Web areas are never rendered in the returned screenshot.

Because aTable and formName are both optional, a pointer-returning function call (e.g. Current form table->, Table->) cannot be passed directly as an argument in compiled mode; use an intermediate pointer variable instead.

overloadMerges.note: formPict is filled by the command (parameter table arrow '←'), so its direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'. Documented the two mutually-linked optional leading parameters (aTable/formName) as a joint constraint, since they only make sense together.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table form only: table of the form (requires formName to also be passed)

params.name: formName
params.description: Name of the form template to screenshot as displayed in the Form editor; if omitted (with aTable), screenshots the form currently being executed/loaded instead

params.name: pageNum
params.description: Page number to screenshot; only meaningful with the form-editor-template syntax (formName passed)

jointConstraints.rule: aTable is only meaningful when formName is also passed (table-form template lookup); passing aTable alone without formName is not a valid combination.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a picture of a form: either a live screenshot of the form currently being executed/loaded (no formName), or a static screenshot of a named form template as rendered in the Form editor (formName passed, optionally at a specific pageNum).
